fusions.name: Churned Pasture
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, bursting spores that deal 26 nature damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring armour, and give them Rot for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Head-Down Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 blunt damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and with [Creeping Death] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Chewed Cud
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
